description: S57 T9 (VG19): the unmet side of the agent's DoD door — a mark is a statement, and an unmet (or unverifiable) is free from an agent: no evidence is named and none is demanded (a run id on a non-met is refused — a run is evidence only a met carries), and the note rides the audit row as audit text within its 512-byte bound. The item keeps its loop, its text and its position; only the state, the evidence (cleared — the unmet names nothing) and the actor stamp move, with the updatedAt. The answer is the item as it now stands.
